name: RC-B10-0191/2024 – After § 11 – Am 10
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text: 11a. Recalls the massacres of Poles in Volhynia and the eastern Małopolska region from 1943 to 1945, which were committed by members of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army; stresses the obligation of Ukraine to fully apologise for the atrocities, allow the exhumation of all victims and prohibit the veneration of historical personalities responsible for the massacres;
